story.title: AI Chip Bets Suffer $34M Liquidation Wipeout As Bitcoin, Ethereum Near Danger Zone Ahead Of Black Monday Fears - Yahoo Finance

facts.text: Bitcoin (BTC) traded just above a cluster of leveraged long bets on Sunday.
The wipeout hit contracts tied to Micron (MU), SanDisk (SNDK) and SK Hynix (SKHY) one day before the 39th anniversary of the Black Monday crash.
Bitcoin is now trading near its next risk zone.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
Bitcoin traded near its $80,862 long liquidation-risk level, while Ethereum hovered close to its comparable $2,354 threshold.
Crypto venues recorded over $33 million in liquidations tied to AI chip stocks, with leveraged long positions accounting for most losses.
Most liquidations on Saturday were long positions, or bets on prices rising.

Crypto venues recorded over $33 million in liquidations tied to AI chip stocks, with leveraged long positions accounting for most losses.SOXL contracts led with $13.05 million liquidated, followed by SanDisk and Micron.Bitcoin traded near its $80,862 long liquidation-risk level, while Ethereum hovered close to its comparable $2,354 threshold.Bitcoin (BTC) traded just above a cluster of leveraged long bets on Sunday.
Bitcoin Sits Near Danger ZoneThe chip losses were included in a broader wave of forced selling.
The largest single liquidation was a $7.27 million short on Binance’s contract for the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares (SOXS).Bitcoin is now trading near its next risk zone.
CoinGlass data also showed more than 4,000 traders had been liquidated on five chip-linked contracts.

The wipeout hit contracts tied to Micron (MU), SanDisk (SNDK) and SK Hynix (SKHY) one day before the 39th anniversary of the Black Monday crash.AI Chip Liquidations As Leveraged Longs Get Wiped OutThe losses were seen in perpetual futures, contracts that have no expiration date and follow the price of a stock.
Bitcoin Sits Near Danger ZoneThe chip losses were included in a broader wave of forced selling.
The largest single liquidation was a $7.27 million short on Binance’s contract for the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares (SOXS).Bitcoin is now trading near its next risk zone.

On Stocktwits, the retail sentiment around BTC moved to ‘extremely bearish’ from the ‘bearish’ zone, while chatter around it stayed at ‘low’ levels over the past day.Leveraged Bets Face RiskAt that level, about $46.39 million in long positions would be liquidated, data from CoinGlass showed.
CoinGlass data also showed more than 4,000 traders had been liquidated on five chip-linked contracts.

Traders kept placing bets even as Wall Street was closed, with exchanges such as Binance and OKX offering around-the-clock trading.A liquidation event occurs when an exchange liquidates a leveraged position that has run out of margin.
